stills.caption: The draft arrives filled in: title, team, priority, status, labels and a description. Every field is editable.
When an open issue already covers it, the draft offers a comment on that issue instead of a second one.
Esc hides the draft to a chip above the prompt; 8 reopens it, 9 twice discards it.

video.caption: /linear drafts an issue from a note: team, priority, status, labels and a description you can edit. Esc hides the draft to a chip, 8 brings it back.
